name: red-spider-girl-nyc-street
image_purpose: Create a social street portrait with original superhero styling and coffee prop.

prompt.project_info: UGC street-fashion outdoor-urban original superhero portrait.
prompt.main_subject: One original adult woman with shoulder-length red hair pulled back, fair skin, light freckles and a playful confident expression. She wears an original full-body red-and-deep-blue web-pattern superhero suit made from textured spandex/mesh, with realistic fabric folds and a non-branded chest emblem. Do not depict a named actress or copyrighted character likeness.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical candid portrait. The subject stands upright on a New York City street, holding a white disposable coffee cup with cardboard sleeve near the chest and raising the other hand in a peace sign. Red brick apartment buildings, black fire escapes, concrete sidewalk and blurred pedestrians in winter coats form the background with soft bokeh.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused overcast daylight, even facial illumination, realistic reflections on the suit and relaxed off-duty city mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Cinematic street photography, 85mm portrait lens, f/1.8 shallow depth of field, sharp face and suit texture, 8K ultra-detailed photorealism, ray-traced render look.
